test_title: PYST 73: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In November 2025, the standing committee of the National Board for Wildlife approved a proposal to construct a Pinjoli bridge in which of the following wildlife sanctuaries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Standing Committee** of the **National Board for Wildlife (NBWL)**, in its meeting held in **November 2025**, cleared the proposal for the construction of the **Pinjoli bridge**.
 
• The bridge is located within the **Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary**, situated in the **West Kameng** district of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• This infrastructure project is a critical component of the **Bhalukpong-Charduar-Tawang (BCT) road**, which is of **strategic importance** for the movement of **defense forces** and logistics toward the **Line of Actual Control (LAC)**.
 
• The **Pinjoli bridge** construction involves the diversion of forest land, and the approval was granted with specific **mitigation measures** to ensure the protection of the local **flora and fauna**.
 
• The **NBWL** is the apex body in India for all wildlife-related matters and its approval is mandatory for any project passing through **protected areas** like **national parks** and **sanctuaries**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• Located in **Arunachal Pradesh**, it covers an area of approximately **218 square kilometers**.
 
• It gained international fame in **2006** following the discovery of a rare bird species named **Bugun Liocichla**.
 
• The sanctuary is part of the **Kameng Elephant Reserve** and is known for its incredible **altitudinal range**, varying from **500 meters** to **3,250 meters**.
 
 
 
• **Dehing Patkai Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• Located in the **Dibrugarh** and **Tinsukia** districts of **Assam**, it is often referred to as the **"Amazon of the East"**.
 
• It was officially declared a **National Park** in **June 2021**. It is the only sanctuary in India that is home to **seven different species of wild cats**.
 
 
 
• **Sepahijala Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• This sanctuary is located in **Tripura** and is famous for its **Clouded Leopard National Park**.
 
• It is a prominent site for the conservation of the **Phayre's leaf monkey** (also known as the **Spectacled Monkey**), which is the state animal of **Tripura**.
 
 
 
• **Dzukou Valley Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• Situated at the border of **Nagaland** and **Manipur**, it is renowned for its **natural beauty** and seasonal blooms of the **Dzukou Lily**.
 
• The valley is a popular **trekking destination** and faces ecological threats from **forest fires** and unregulated tourism.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Board for Wildlife (NBWL):** It is a **statutory body** constituted under the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**. The **Prime Minister** serves as the **ex-officio chairman** of the board.
 
• **Border Roads Organization (BRO):** Most strategic bridges in this region, including those near **Eaglenest**, are executed by the **BRO** under **Project Vartak** to enhance **national security** infrastructure.
 
• **Wildlife Clearances:** Any non-forestry activity within a **protected area** requires a recommendation from the **Standing Committee** of the **NBWL** after initial scrutiny by the **State Board for Wildlife**.
